newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees strong demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees strong demand.

text.p: Strong demand was seen at the latest London tea auction, an official report said.
It said that in the landed sector bright liquoring East Africans met keen competition and prices advanced 5 to 10 pence sterling. Coloury mediums appreciated 2 to 4 pence with others firm.
In the offshores, coloury Central Africans often showed substantial gains but others were rather irregular. London NewsRoom - 44 171 542 7729
